sonnet.problem: The card says the prophets' claim that Babylon's king would not come came while 'the Chaldeans had already been besieging Jerusalem!' and cites Jeremiah 37:5. Verse 19 never links the prophets' claim to the siege in verse 5. The card also adds the word 'already', which sets a timing the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
